answer_1.quote: We then develop a claim synthesis method in order to generate claims that require multisource knowledge to verify, which uses a fine-grained claim manipulator model to generate claims manipulated at the sub-claim level.

answer_3.quote: we employ Mixtral-8x7B using in-context learning to predict the logical label of the claims generated by the claim manipulator as a quality check; we discard those that do not align with the target labels.
